assignments.description: Idempotent path. The file is already with a senior, so nothing is written and the owner is left alone — re-running must not re-stamp the reason or bounce ownership. The existing reason and a fresh evidence trail are still returned, so the agent can explain the state it found.
assignments.name: Set_Already_Escalated
assignments.label: Set Already Escalated

assignments.description: Returns the full evidence trail the analyst needs to act without reopening the record: the confidence band and exactly which signals are missing, the declared and verified figures, the disparity, and the bureau result.
assignments.name: Set_Escalated_Outputs
assignments.label: Set Escalated Outputs

assignments.description: Neither trigger fired. Nothing is written, and the evidence trail is still returned so the agent can show its working for deciding not to escalate.
assignments.name: Set_No_Escalation
assignments.label: Set No Escalation

value.stringValue: No escalation trigger met: grounding confidence is not Low and no financial disparity is flagged.

assignments.description: The supplied Id matched nothing the running user can see. Returns a stated failure rather than silently reporting no escalation, which would read to the agent as an assessed all-clear.
assignments.name: Set_Not_Found
assignments.label: Set Not Found

value.stringValue: No Loan Application was found for the supplied Id, so no assessment was made.
No Loan Application was found for the supplied Id. No evidence could be gathered.

constants.description: Must match CONFIDENCE_LOW in Loan Application Grounding Confidence Calc. The two are a pair: change one and this action stops firing.
constants.name: CONFIDENCE_LOW

constants.description: Escalation target, held as a username rather than a record Id so nothing in source is org-specific. Production: senior QUEUE (A2) — a queue survives the analyst leaving, taking leave, or being reassigned, which a named user does not.
constants.name: SENIOR_ANALYST_USERNAME

decisions.description: Idempotency gate. Runs before the trigger test so that a second call on an escalated file is a no-op regardless of why it was escalated the first time.
decisions.name: Already_Escalated
decisions.label: Already Escalated?

decisions.description: Guards every downstream reference. An unknown or invisible Id must not fall through to the no-escalation path, which would look like a clean assessment.
decisions.name: Application_Found
decisions.label: Application Found?

decisions.description: Low grounding confidence is the primary trigger — the requirement is that confidence below threshold routes to a senior. A raised disparity flag escalates as well, and is named separately in the reason so the two causes are never conflated in the audit trail.
decisions.name: Should_Escalate
decisions.label: Should Escalate?

Flow.description: Action 6. Routes a loan application to a senior credit analyst when grounding confidence is Low or a financial disparity is flagged, and returns the evidence trail behind that decision. Never clears Escalated__c on any path — closing an escalation requires the Can_Clear_Escalation permission, which the Only_Senior_Can_Clear_Escalation validation rule enforces against direct edits too.

formulas.description: Turns the stored band value back into its name for presentation. The field is a Percent so it renders as 100.00%, which is readable on a layout but not what an analyst wants read aloud.
formulas.name: fmlConfidenceBand

formulas.description: Deterministic and system-generated, never narrative. The confidence clause names the band and the specific missing signals, because an escalation that says only "low confidence" gives the senior nothing to act on. A disparity clause is appended after it as a plain statement of the two figures disagreeing — it reports an observation, never a lending opinion.
formulas.name: fmlEscalationReason
formulas.expression: IF({!Get_Loan_Application.Grounding_Confidence__c} = {!CONFIDENCE_LOW}, "Low grounding confidence (" & TEXT({!Get_Loan_Application.Grounding_Confidence__c}) & "%). Missing evidence: " & BLANKVALUE({!Get_Loan_Application.Grounding_Signals_Missing__c}, "not recorded") & ". ", "") & IF({!Get_Loan_Application.Financial_Disparity_Flag__c}, "Declared vs verified revenue disparity of " & TEXT({!Get_Loan_Application.Financial_Disparity_Percent__c}) & "%.", "")

formulas.description: Everything the senior needs without reopening the record. States the confidence AND why it is what it is, which is the part a confidence escalation must carry. Figures are reported as "not provided" rather than zero when absent — a missing number and a zero mean very different things on a credit file.
formulas.name: fmlEvidenceTrail
formulas.expression: "Grounding confidence: " & TEXT({!Get_Loan_Application.Grounding_Confidence__c}) & "% (" & {!fmlConfidenceBand} & "). " & IF(LEN(BLANKVALUE({!Get_Loan_Application.Grounding_Signals_Missing__c}, "")) > 0, "Evidence missing: " & {!Get_Loan_Application.Grounding_Signals_Missing__c} & ". ", "All evidence signals present. ") & "Declared revenue: " & IF(ISBLANK({!Get_Loan_Application.Declared_Annual_Revenue__c}), "not provided", TEXT({!Get_Loan_Application.Declared_Annual_Revenue__c})) & ". Verified revenue: " & IF(ISBLANK({!Get_Loan_Application.Verified_Annual_Revenue__c}), "not provided", TEXT({!Get_Loan_Application.Verified_Annual_Revenue__c})) & ". Disparity: " & IF(ISBLANK({!Get_Loan_Application.Financial_Disparity_Percent__c}), "not computed", TEXT({!Get_Loan_Application.Financial_Disparity_Percent__c}) & "%") & ". Bureau: " & IF(ISBLANK({!Get_Latest_Credit_Check.Credit_Score__c}), "no current credit check on file", "score " & TEXT({!Get_Latest_Credit_Check.Credit_Score__c}) & ", reference " & {!Get_Latest_Credit_Check.Credit_Check_Reference__c}) & ". Policy citations available via the credit policy search action."

Flow.label: Escalate To Senior Analyst

recordLookups.description: The current bureau file, for the evidence trail. Its absence is itself evidence, so a null result is expected rather than an error — the confidence calc has already counted it as a missing signal.
recordLookups.name: Get_Latest_Credit_Check
recordLookups.label: Get Latest Credit Check

recordLookups.description: Loads the file under assessment. Runs before any decision so that a bad Id is caught explicitly rather than producing a confident-looking no-escalation result.
recordLookups.name: Get_Loan_Application
recordLookups.label: Get Loan Application

recordLookups.description: Resolves the escalation target by username, so no 18-character Id is baked into source and the flow survives an org rebuild. Production: senior QUEUE (A2).
recordLookups.name: Get_Senior_Analyst
recordLookups.label: Get Senior Analyst

recordUpdates.description: Raises the flag, records the deterministic reason, and hands the file over. Escalated__c is only ever set to true here — no path in this flow clears it, because the analyst whose work triggered the escalation must not be able to close it.
recordUpdates.name: Update_Loan_Application
recordUpdates.label: Update Loan Application

variables.description: True when this file was already escalated before the call, so nothing was changed. Say so rather than reporting a fresh escalation — the analyst needs to know the routing is not new.
variables.name: varAlreadyEscalated

variables.description: The confidence band as a word: High, Medium or Low. Use this rather than the raw number when explaining the outcome.
variables.name: varConfidenceBand

variables.description: True when the application is now with a senior analyst. False means no trigger was met or the application could not be found — check the reason before telling anyone the file is clear.
variables.name: varEscalated

variables.description: The deterministic reason the file was routed, naming the confidence band and the specific missing evidence, followed by any declared-vs-verified disparity. Present this verbatim; do not paraphrase it into a credit opinion.
variables.name: varEscalationReason

variables.description: The full evidence behind the decision: confidence and why it is what it is, declared and verified revenue, disparity, and the current bureau result. Present this to the analyst alongside the reason. Figures reading "not provided" are genuinely absent, not zero.
variables.name: varEvidenceTrail

variables.description: The stored confidence value: 100 High, 50 Medium, 20 Low. Measures whether the evidence needed to assess the file is present, and says nothing about whether the loan is a good one.
variables.name: varGroundingConfidence

variables.description: Record Id of the Loan Application to assess for escalation. This is the 18-character Id of the Loan Application record the user is viewing or has named, not the LA-0001 application number and not the applicant's Account Id.
variables.name: varLoanApplicationId

variables.description: Name of the senior analyst the file was handed to. Empty when nothing was escalated.
variables.name: varOwnerName

variables.description: Semicolon-separated list of the evidence signals absent from the file, e.g. "verified financials; current credit check". Empty when nothing is missing. This is the WHY behind a low confidence band.
variables.name: varSignalsMissing
